meta.title: Build your own video sharing site
meta.author: videowhisper
meta.description: Eight fictional video entries with generated posters, native layout controls, illustrative ratings/likes and optional FansPaysite light/dark appearance. No real payments or processing. Latest verified native listings with fictional generated creator/content imagery. No real payment or membership grant is simulated. Native video editor blocks reuse the existing access rules. Native page presets, category name search and an editable-video picker simplify page building. Agent assistance returns read-only review proposals and never grants an external connection automatically. Editorial previews retain the standalone native editor; optional Site Manager private reviews require separately approved tools. Membership repeat saves retain their existing policy. Wallet renewal settings are available but default off. This SQLite demo never enables funding or seeds paid terms; native-wallet continuation requires separately qualified InnoDB hosting and explicit administrator/fan consent.
